announcements.html:
Hi everyone,

We are currently running low on P200 pipette tips, and unfortunately, most of our usual suppliers are experiencing backorders, with availability not expected until at least early next year.

Fortunately, I was able to secure a cost-effective alternative from MIDSCI: sterile, 200 µL filtered, low-retention pipette tips.

Please take some time to try these tips and share your feedback on their performance and compatibility with our pipettes. If they work well for everyone, we may temporarily switch to this brand until our usual tips become available again.

Thanks, everyone!
